verdict.rationale: All five core products (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index) are exposed through REST, multi-language SDKs, a CLI and an MCP endpoint. Docs also present API and Web UI as interchangeable entry points, and Extract is explicitly offered as web UI, SDK and REST API. Webhooks and saved configurations referenced by ID support automation. However, no documentation explicitly claims full UI/API parity, and administrative functions such as SSO/RBAC, org/project management and extraction-config authoring have no evidenced API equivalent. Probes also found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit UI–API parity statement, API coverage of admin features (RBAC, projects, org settings), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
